comments.author: Jehree Senior Moderator
comments.body_html:
I know I’m biased but here are some ways I have used it / seen other people use it.

Find a quest item you’ll need later but don’t have room for it right now? (Or you are using Fika and a friend needs it?) Place it!

Have Fika installed and your friend died? Place their gear so they can come back and get it.

I’ve used it to stash bolt action rifles with a scope and some ammo in sniping spots, so I can pop over and take some shots even if I didn’t bring a sniper.

You could stash some food and water somewhere just in case you forget it. Could stash some money at car extract… the list really goes on and on.

With Lockable Doors + an addon I will be releasing HOPEFULLY soon called Home Comforts (there’s a test build on my github if you don’t want to wait though) that lets you exfil and infil at a “safehouse”.. you could even use it to build a base.

So however you want to
